assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D arcade sprite atlas for Frog Hop, a friendly road-and-river crossing game, transparent PNG. Draw an EXACT 4 column by 4 row regular grid, 16 independently isolated sprites, equal cells, no grid lines. Row 1: same bright lime-green tree frog viewed from directly above, facing up, 4 hop-cycle frames (crouch, stretch, midair, landing). Row 2: four top-down compact cars pointing right: coral coupe, yellow taxi without text, blue van, cream station wagon. Row 3: four horizontal floating driftwood logs, with warm rich bark, pale cut ends, subtle moss and distinctive wood texture; same long narrow collision silhouette each. Row 4: four round lily pad home docks, from empty dark green leaf with yellow flower to three slight leaf/flower animation variations, no frog. Camera strictly orthographic overhead. Polished hand-painted arcade pixel art with crisp silhouette edges and fine material highlights, designed for a 768x480 game, each object will be sampled to about 90x50 pixels. Every sprite centered in its cell, 15 percent transparent margin, all frogs consistent scale, logs/cars horizontally longer than tall. Transparent background only, no shadows outside object, no text, no labels, no scenery, no known game characters. Make readable high contrast.

conversion.resize: Lanczos from measured original ImageGen crops; fitted to existing collision silhouettes; alpha >=160 to RGB565 chroma key 0
